reviewItem.question: If an exposed environment does nothing about "Ignoring resource updates configured in `ignoreDifferences` by default: By default, the existing system-level `ignoreDifferences` customizations will be added…", what happens, and is that review or action? proposed: behavior-change

consequence.statement: System-level ignoreDifferences customizations are now applied to resource updates by default, which may reduce the number of diffs generated for applications. Fields configured to be ignored will no longer trigger diffs when changed.

proposed.statement: By default, system-level ignoreDifferences customizations are now applied to ignore resource updates; set ignoreDifferencesOnResourceUpdates to false to preserve the v2 default behavior.
